title: Mini Belt Grinder 3-in-1 – Knife Sharpener & Polisher
descriptionHtml:
Dull knives, rusty edges and a sharpening job that never got done

Sharpening by hand takes technique, time and patience. The result shows it – and the knife stays dull in the drawer.

The solution: the belt does the work, you control the angle

A mini belt grinder with 7 speeds and a 15-degree sharpening angle. Sharpen knives, polish metal and shape wood – three machines in one, compact enough for a hobby workbench.

Features

  • An even edge every time – 15° belt angle
  • Three machines in one – grinding, polishing and buffing
  • The right speed for the material – 7 speeds
  • Fits on the smallest workbench
  • For knives, wood, metal and jewelry
